import csv
import math
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import numpy as np
import sklearn
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

expr_path, meta_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

with open(meta_path, 'r') as handle:
    meta_rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
if not meta_rows or 'projid' not in meta_rows[0]:
    raise ValueError('Metadata must contain projid')
meta_ids = [row['projid'] for row in meta_rows]
meta_counts = Counter(meta_ids)

with open(expr_path, 'r') as handle:
    reader = csv.reader(handle)
    header = next(reader)
    if not header or header[0] != 'gene':
        raise ValueError('Expression first column must be gene')
    expr_ids = header[1:]
    expr_counts = Counter(expr_ids)
    if expr_counts != meta_counts:
        raise ValueError('Expression and metadata sample-ID multiplicities differ')
    duplicate_ids = set(sample_id for sample_id, count in expr_counts.items() if count > 1)
    keep_indices = [i for i, sample_id in enumerate(expr_ids) if sample_id not in duplicate_ids]
    kept_ids = [expr_ids[i] for i in keep_indices]
    genes = []
    columns = []
    for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, 2):
        if len(row) != len(header):
            raise ValueError('Expression row width mismatch at row %d' % row_number)
        genes.append(row[0])
        values = [float(row[i + 1]) for i in keep_indices]
        columns.append(values)

if len(set(genes)) != len(genes):
    raise ValueError('Gene labels are not unique')
if len(set(kept_ids)) != len(kept_ids):
    raise ValueError('Fitted sample labels are not unique')
matrix = np.asarray(columns, dtype=float).T
if matrix.shape != (len(kept_ids), len(genes)):
    raise ValueError('Unexpected fitted matrix shape')
if not np.isfinite(matrix).all():
    raise ValueError('Expression contains non-finite values')
if (matrix < 0).any():
    raise ValueError('Expression contains negative values')

matrix = np.log10(matrix + 1.0)
variances = np.var(matrix, axis=0, ddof=1)
nonconstant = variances > 0
matrix = matrix[:, nonconstant]
if matrix.shape[1] < 100 or matrix.shape[0] < 101:
    raise ValueError('Insufficient matrix rank bounds for 100 components')

model = PCA(n_components=100, svd_solver='full')
model.fit(matrix)
pc1_percent = float(model.explained_variance_ratio_[0] * 100.0)
if not (0.0 <= pc1_percent <= 100.0):
    raise ValueError('PC1 percentage outside [0, 100]')

with open('pca_summary.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('metric\tvalue\n')
    out.write('method\tsklearn.decomposition.PCA\n')
    out.write('sklearn_version\t%s\n' % sklearn.__version__)
    out.write('input_genes\t%d\n' % len(genes))
    out.write('input_sample_columns\t%d\n' % len(expr_ids))
    out.write('unique_primary_sample_ids\t%d\n' % len(expr_counts))
    out.write('unresolved_duplicate_id_groups\t%d\n' % len(duplicate_ids))
    out.write('excluded_duplicate_records\t%d\n' % sum(expr_counts[x] for x in duplicate_ids))
    out.write('fitted_samples\t%d\n' % matrix.shape[0])
    out.write('fitted_nonconstant_genes\t%d\n' % matrix.shape[1])
    out.write('transform\tlog10(x+1)\n')
    out.write('feature_centering\ttrue\n')
    out.write('feature_scaling\tfalse\n')
    out.write('n_components\t100\n')
    out.write('svd_solver\tfull\n')
    out.write('variance_denominator\ttotal variance of all fitted nonconstant genes\n')
    out.write('pc1_explained_variance_fraction\t%.17g\n' % float(model.explained_variance_ratio_[0]))
    out.write('pc1_explained_variance_percent\t%.17g\n' % pc1_percent)
PY
